picks.rationale: Home Depot beat Q3 estimates with EPS of $3.86 vs $3.84 expected and revenue of $43.4B vs $42.8B, comps rose 2.2% and full-year sales guidance was raised to ~+4.5% [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/17/home-depot-hd-q3-earnings-2026.html). With a P/E of 23.54, 2.75% dividend yield, and low short interest of 1.29%, it offers a balanced risk/reward.

Lowe's posted a strong Q3 beat with EPS of $3.10 vs $2.88 expected and revenue of $22.76B vs $22.41B, comps rose 1.8% and full-year sales guidance was raised to ~$92.5B [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/18/lowes-low-q3-2026-earnings.html). Trading at a P/E of 18.53 with a 2.26% dividend yield and +12.35% one-month momentum.

MGM Resorts reported Q3 results with MGM China achieving record quarterly revenue and market share of 17.1%, and October Las Vegas results rebounded favorably [mgmresorts.com](https://investors.mgmresorts.com/2026-10-28-MGM-RESORTS-INTERNATIONAL-REPORTS-THIRD-QUARTER-2026-FINANCIAL-AND-OPERATING-RESULTS). With a P/E of 12.45, +12.09% one-month momentum, and an amended voting agreement clearing the way for share buybacks [yahoo.com](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/why-mgm-resorts-mgm-stock-220419076.html), it is undervalued.

PulteGroup shows strong momentum with +10.43% one-month gain and +5.38% YTD, trading at an attractive P/E of 13.32 with a beta of 1.179. The homebuilding sector benefits from resilient demand despite higher mortgage rates.

McDonald's has +10.96% one-month momentum and a low beta of 0.431, trading at a P/E of 21.62 with a 2.83% dividend yield. Its defensive qualities and global pricing power make it attractive in a cautious consumer environment.
Domino's has +12.04% one-month momentum and a P/E of 19.21, with a 2.28% dividend yield. Its value-oriented menu and delivery model are well-positioned for budget-conscious consumers.

Tractor Supply has strong +17.59% one-month momentum and +5.46% one-week gain, trading at a P/E of 20.67 with a 2.5% dividend yield. Its focus on rural and hobby-farm customers provides a stable revenue base.

Chipotle has +26.42% one-month momentum and a P/E of 33.22, reflecting strong brand loyalty and pricing power. Despite a higher valuation, its recent surge indicates positive sentiment and operational strength.
Kingfisher has +10.35% one-month momentum and +19.96% YTD, trading at a P/E of 21.08 with a 3.27% dividend yield. The home improvement retailer benefits from steady DIY demand and a strong UK market.

Carvana has +7.87% one-month momentum despite a high beta of 3.65 and short interest of 12.1%, trading at a P/E of 30.7. The used-car market recovery and improving operational efficiency support a speculative buy.
